source.name: Avito chats + CRM backup
source.note: Messages and metadata are copied from the provided export. Existing CRM fields are preserved when a legacy record can be matched; unmatched legacy rows remain in legacyClients.
source.identityPolicy: One record per Avito dialogue; use source_dialogue_id (D001..D229) as the primary key. Same display names are not merged.
source.classificationPolicy: 206 records are classified as legal clients by the audit; 23 are preserved separately as service, other or insufficient-content records.
qualityNotes: Messages and available structured data are copied from the export.
Images, voice messages and attachments have metadata only; their contents were not reconstructed.
Deleted messages and text truncated in the export were not reconstructed.
Audit topics, questions, objections, stages and outcomes are derived annotations, not current legal truth or proof of a favourable result.
A textual payment acknowledgement is not bank verification; screenshots and requests for payment are not treated as confirmed payment.
229 dialogues are not guaranteed to be 229 unique people.
Historical prices and legal norms are preserved as source context and are not automatically treated as current pricing or law.
source.importGuidance: Use the strict legal file if the CRM accepts only clients and finance. Use this categorized file as the full archive and enrichment source.
source.note_payment: Payment evidence is preserved as textual account acknowledgement only and is not bank verified.
source.mainStatusPolicy: Legacy CRM statuses are authoritative for 97 existing cards. New archive records are forced to done or cancel; they are never assigned wait/work.
source.conversationDataPolicy: Message arrays, dialogue archive, copied service transcripts and payment evidence text were removed. CRM keeps only card metadata and manually editable fields.
source.workingSetPolicy: Legacy CRM statuses are preserved. New archive cards remain only in done/cancel.
